meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在每次回答前会自动翻出之前对话中相关的记忆，并在每轮对话结束后把新信息存下来。这样即使开启新对话，它也能记得以前说过的事。
howto.when: 当你在装有该技能的默认 Claude 代理上聊天时，每次回复前它都会检索相关历史，每轮结束后自动保存新内容。仅对 Claude provider 生效。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次谈的服务器配置吗？
say.note: 它会从记忆里检索相关对话并回答。

say.text: 记住：项目截止日期是下周五。
say.note: 这轮结束后这条信息会被存入长期记忆。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的要点存起来，下次问你时用上。
say.note: 它会在每轮后自动保存，这样下次对话就能调用。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude recalls relevant past context before each response and stores new insights after each turn, so it remembers earlier conversations across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggers during chats with agents using this skill under the default Claude provider: before each reply it retrieves related memory, and after each turn it saves new insights.

say_en.text: Do you remember the server setup we discussed last time?
say_en.note: It will search memory and answer with relevant context.

say_en.text: Remember: the project deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: This insight is stored after the turn ends.

say_en.text: Save the points we just discussed and use them next time.
say_en.note: It auto-saves after each turn, so a future chat can call them up.
